create_hpatches_dataset: create an HPatchesDataset instance to load image pairs with homography matrices from a directory
filter_hpatches_illumination: filter HPatchesDataset to load only illumination-altered image pairs using img_alteration='i'
resize_hpatches_images: resize HPatchesDataset images by a float scale factor or explicit (height, width) tuple
limit_hpatches_load: limit HPatchesDataset to a specific number of image sets using num_to_load parameter
iterate_hpatches_dataset: iterate HPatchesDataset to retrieve original images, warped images, and homography tensors
